0.1.0

  • The .rtsx transpiler, reactogenic check, the language server.
  • The Vite plugin.

Reactogenic compiles the shell of every page once. The layout components run in the compiler and leave plain HTML behind, so paragraph 1 of this page costs exactly its own bytes and nothing else.
